  Beginner? Start here.

  A bug report tells us something isn't working right. You don't need to know

  Every report helps, even short ones.

## Severity

- [ ] **P0 (blocker)**: Completely prevents a core task
- [ ] **P1 (major)**: Significant impact, workaround exists
- [ ] **P2 (minor)**: Cosmetic or low-impact issue

[What happened instead.]
